snippet.title: 【NAGAMES】toilet - trailer
snippet.description:
toilet: urinal game (aka Toilet Chess) — a turn-based strategy board game set in a men's restroom. The unwritten urinal rule — never stand next to anyone — is now a game of pure strategy.

■ Simple Rules, Deep Strategy
Red and Blue take turns placing people at urinals. You can't place next to someone already there. If you can't make a move, you lose.

■ 30 Unique Stages
From simple lines to complex layouts. Stalls add a strategic twist.

■ Online Multiplayer
Rated matches worldwide with Elo rankings, or challenge friends with an invite code.

■ Free to Play
Optional Pro upgrade removes ads. No dice, no randomness — pure strategy.

Download free on iOS:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/toilet-urinal-game/id6783363464

More info:
https://toilet.nagames.io
